```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

```

Loading CSV file

```{r}
antibiotics <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")

gt(head(antibiotics))

```

My data set is for the rate of access so consumtion of antiobiotics between the years 2018 and 2026


Exercise: Plotting public health data 

```{r}

antibiotics <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")

antibiotics <- antibiotics|> group_by(year) |> mutate(mean_consumption = mean(metric_value)) |> distinct(year, mean_consumption)

ggplot(antibiotics, aes(
  x = year,
  y = mean_consumption
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "blue") +
  xlab("Year") +
  ylab("standardised consumption") +
  ggtitle("Access to consumtion of antibiotics per year")

```
